description.value: The Central Branch is the flagship location of the Greater Victoria Public Library system, situated in downtown Victoria. It houses the Heritage Room, a broad physical and digital collection, and public computer access, making it a genuine community hub. Touring cyclists passing through the city core may find it a convenient stop for connectivity and rest.
